summary: Updated all 20 Phase 2 config parameters with rationale comments. Updated test assertions to match new values and fixed test logic for JOINT_TRAIN_VAL=True default. All 1334 tests pass.
notes_for_reviewer: No logic changes in production code - only config.py parameter values and comments updated.
Test files updated to assert new parameter values and accommodate JOINT_TRAIN_VAL=True default (test_phase2_val_sim_interval, test_evox_runner, test_phase2_rule_pool).
Key change: JOINT_TRAIN_VAL=True causes val to run every gen, so test_val_skipped_on_non_interval_gens now explicitly sets JOINT_TRAIN_VAL=False.
PHASE2_ISLAND_TOTAL_GENERATIONS stays linked to PHASE2_GENERATIONS (no change needed).
PHASE2_ORPHAN_ENABLED=False leaves orphan hyperparams in place but inactive - can be re-enabled easily.
